entry.title: Brazilians in the US relieved after Lula’s come-from-behind election victory

media:group.media:title: Brazilians in the US relieved after Lula’s come-from-behind election victory
media:group.media:description:
Brazilian nationals in the U.S. express relief but caution following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s presidential election victory. Community members credit young voters and increased turnout while acknowledging concerns about corruption and political divisions. As Lula prepares for his next term as President beginning January 2027, supporters say his ability to build alliances will be crucial to governing Brazil.

entry.title: Anthropic files for potentially the biggest IPO ever

media:group.media:title: Anthropic files for potentially the biggest IPO ever
media:group.media:description:
The filing sets up the San Francisco company for a Wall Street debut next month, potentially eclipsing the SpaceX initial public offering in June that raised a record $86 billion. An Anthropic IPO would also put the company ahead of OpenAI in going public in what is expected to be a pair of blockbuster stock debuts for the rival AI labs.

entry.title: London’s Oxford Street bans traffic as the city tries to boost its shopping district

media:group.media:title: London’s Oxford Street bans traffic as the city tries to boost its shopping district
media:group.media:description:

The move marked the first step in a makeover of the storied shopping precinct, with plans to plant trees, install seating and add two new public squares. (AP Video by Kwiyeon Ha)
